references.text: God brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand, a recurring theme in Balaam's prophecy
Nearly identical wording describing God leading Israel out of Egypt with the strength of a wild ox
Describes Joseph's strength as that of a wild ox (רְאֵם) who butts the peoples
Uses the image of the wild ox's horns (רְאֵם) as a symbol of strength
God leads Israel out and guides them, parallel to the deliverance from Egypt
Israel will devour the nations living in the land, parallel to consuming enemies
God will hand over the peoples to Israel to be destroyed
God's arrows are used against enemies, parallel to crushing with arrows
God uses His arrows against enemies, parallel to the arrows that crush
The breaking of bones as an image of the complete destruction of enemies
